product.product: MODIS Collection 6.1 active fire product (Terra MOD14 / Aqua MYD14)
product.data_source: NASA FIRMS Area API, standard processing
product.note: Genuine NASA FIRMS observations. Bounding-box row counts are the raw rows returned for the study-area bounding box and include detections outside the administrative boundary; district detections are the records that survived exact point-in-polygon assignment.

quality_control.scope: whole standard-processing record (pre-2012 and post-2012), not pre-2012 alone

calibration_period.note: Only post-2012 overlap observations are used to fit or test the MODIS-to-VIIRS relationship. Pre-2012 records are never training data.

harmonization_summary.reference: VIIRS Suomi-NPP (reference scale, not ground truth)
harmonization_summary.terminology: A 'MODIS-derived VIIRS-equivalent estimate' is a transformed MODIS count. It is not a VIIRS detection.

notes: Bounding-box rows are raw rows returned for the study-area bounding box; they are not district detections and are not comparable across regions.
District detections are exact point-in-polygon assignments and remain on the native MODIS scale.
A month with no files is never reported as zero detections; coverage statuses use the six-state vocabulary (observed / insufficient / incomplete / missing / not_requested / unavailable).
VIIRS-equivalent values are produced only where the regional transferability decision is supported or limited, and are labelled as estimates.
